seo.title: About Katic Designs | Architecture & Interior Design Studio, Kochi
seo.description: Founded in 2013 in Kochi, Katic Designs brings architects, interior designers and site teams together to design and build eco-conscious homes and buildings.

image.alt: Design workstation showing a 3D building model

title: Designing Spaces.
Shaping
hero.lead: Katic Designs is an architecture, interior design and construction practice creating thoughtful spaces across Kerala and the UAE.

title: Architecture With
Purpose
intro.lead: We believe good design begins with understanding people, place and how a space will be experienced.
intro.body: KATIC brings architecture, interiors, construction, development and property care together in one practice. Our studio works closely with homeowners, developers and businesses from the first conversation to the final handover. By listening before drawing and coordinating every detail, we turn practical needs, local context and individual character into spaces made to last.
